title: Account Management
objective: Manage information system accounts across their lifecycle.
pacRationale: Owner and review-age facts support realistic allow/deny; account lifecycle is a distinct teachable pattern.

title: Access Enforcement
objective: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.
pacRationale: Role and action facts score authorization decisions; distinct from account lifecycle review.

title: Audit Record Generation
objective: Generate audit records for auditable events with content needed for investigation and accountability.
pacRationale: Events-defined / records-generated / content-complete facts teach record generation, not generic retention.

title: Baseline Configuration
objective: Develop, document, and maintain under configuration control a current baseline configuration of the system.
pacRationale: Baseline present and drift facts yield clear allow/deny from config snapshots.

title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
objective: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate authentication with authorized accounts.
pacRationale: Identity and MFA facts support allow/deny; distinct authentication pattern.

title: Boundary Protection
objective: Monitor and control communications at external and key internal managed interfaces.
pacRationale: Interface and flow facts teach boundary allow/deny from firewall/config evidence.

title: Flaw Remediation
objective: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner, including installing security-relevant updates.
pacRationale: Severity and age_days facts encode SLA-faithful allow/deny from ticket or scanner exports.

title: Identity Lifecycle Governance
objective: Provision, review, and remove identities according to business need.
pacRationale: Provisioning and review facts match account-management allow/deny without distorting the control.

title: Continuous Monitoring Logging
objective: Collect, retain, and alert on security-relevant logs so monitoring can detect and investigate events.
pacRationale: Retention and alerting facts match the logging family and the control objective.

title: Configuration Baselines
objective: Establish and maintain approved configuration baselines, detecting unapproved drift.
pacRationale: Baseline and drift facts teach config control without simplification beyond the family.

title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Accounts
objective: Maintain an accurate inventory of accounts with owners and periodic access reviews.
pacRationale: Owner and review-window facts map directly to account inventory allow/deny.

title: Collect Audit Logs
objective: Collect audit logs across enterprise assets to support monitoring and investigation.
pacRationale: Log collection, retention, and alerting facts are queryable and one-drill teachable.

title: Monitor System Activity
objective: Monitor system components and detect anomalies that may indicate security events.
pacRationale: Alerting and retention facts teach monitoring decisions from log/SIEM evidence.

title: Financial System Configuration Baselines
objective: Maintain approved configuration baselines for systems in scope for financial reporting.
pacRationale: Baseline and drift facts apply cleanly to in-scope financial systems.

title: Event Logging
objective: Identify and log event types needed to support monitoring and incident response.
pacRationale: Event logging maps to retention/alerting facts without warping the control objective.

title: Least Privilege
objective: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users and processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks.
pacRationale: Role and action facts teach least privilege; control-faithful access-enforcement family.

title: Continuous Configuration Evidence
objective: Continuously validate cloud resource configurations against an approved baseline.
pacRationale: Continuous validation is simplified into the existing config-baseline drift check.

title: Continuous Identity Evidence
objective: Continuously validate that active accounts have accountable owners and current access reviews.
pacRationale: Continuous identity evidence is still owner + 90-day review via account-management.

title: Authorized Access Control
objective: Limit system access to authorized users and processes acting on behalf of authorized users.
pacRationale: Access-limiting objective is taught via account-management lifecycle rather than a dedicated enforcement pattern.

title: Identify System Users
objective: Identify information system users, processes acting on behalf of users, and devices.
pacRationale: Users/processes/devices facts teach subject identification as a distinct one-drill pattern.
